reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing mode-switch helper for DeepSeek Harness agents: it exposes a `/gamemode` slash command to switch the running agent into the built-in `cordis` creative preset, with a documented way to switch back. Evidence is limited to repository metadata, package manifest, and README, all describing only this command/preset functionality.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过 `/gamemode 1` 快速切换到内置的 cordis 创造模式预设，并可通过 `/gamemode 0` 切回其他模式。
summaries.en: This plugin for DeepSeek Harness adds a `/gamemode` slash command so users can switch to the built-in Cordis creative preset with `/gamemode 1` and revert with `/gamemode 0`.

capabilities: Adds a dsh slash command (`/gamemode`) for agent preset switching.
Switches the agent to the built-in `cordis` Creative Mode preset via `/gamemode 1` as documented.
Supports a reverse/revert command (`/gamemode 0`) according to plugin docs.

reasons.code: Repository description and README define the plugin’s purpose as `/gamemode 1` switching to built-in Creative Mode (`cordis`), with `/gamemode 0` to return.
README explains a single command flow (`/gamemode 1`) and installation as a DSH plugin, indicating no broader feature set is advertised.
Package manifest declares DSH plugin metadata (`dsh.bundle.patch`) and plugin entry points, confirming loadable plugin behavior rather than external tooling or data processing.
